speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: I understand that the Government has developed Pair, which is a suite of AI tools that utilise large language models for internal use within the Public Service.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: Could the Senior Minister of State clarify if Pair is primarily using locally deployed open source models or does it connect to commercial AI platforms, like ChatGPT and DeepSeek that process data on foreign servers?
